main_delivery.method: Full nominal-state PHAROS continuation sampled at 1s. Integrate configured thrust times the sampled inertial body-X axis divided by mass only over the known active burn interval, with 128-point Gauss quadrature. This avoids quadrature across a sampled thrust discontinuity.

trim_delivery.method: Full nominal-state PHAROS continuation sampled at 1s. Integrate configured thrust times the sampled inertial body-X axis divided by mass only over the known active burn interval, with 128-point Gauss quadrature. This avoids quadrature across a sampled thrust discontinuity.

pointing_mapping: Apply the same inertial rotation to the preceding preparation target and the main-burn target, preserving their existing offset. The existing trim target includes its own preparation. Scale throttles for the desired effective increments and changed propellant mass.
